profile.headline: R&D Director | Chief Architect | AI, Data & Cloud-Edge Systems
profile.role: R&D Director, Chief Architect and Senior Engineer
profile.summary: Zhouxing Zhao is an R&D Director, Chief Architect and Senior Engineer at Zhejiang Communications Services Co., Ltd. His research and engineering interests include multimodal AI, embodied intelligence, data assets, low-altitude UAV systems, and cloud-edge collaboration. He combines enterprise architecture and research-driven product development with large-scale engineering delivery, building on earlier work in activity-based costing and data warehouses.

highlights.text: Appointed Committee Member of the Zhejiang Association for Artificial Intelligence.
Recognized with the Most Beautiful Science and Technology Worker honor by China Telecom Association for Science and Technology.
Led and participated in key projects on professional UAV R&D, data-driven code assembly, cloud-edge intelligent cores, and enterprise data governance.
Team achievements include recognition for Zhejiang Multimodal Intelligent IoT Communication Technology Key Enterprise Research Institute and Zhejiang Comservice advanced team.
Recognized as Excellent Architect by Zhejiang Smart City Promotion Association.

documents.title: Academic Profile and Research Record
documents.summary: Academic background and a dated CNKI research record: five journal articles, one master's thesis and 20 distinct inventions, 16 with granted records.
documents.text: Academic Profile and Research Record Zhouxing Zhao is a Senior Engineer and Chief Architect at Zhejiang Communications Services Co., Ltd., part of China Communications Services. His CNKI profile lists computer software, multimodal systems, data elements and embodied intelligence as research interests, with communications and information systems as the subject area. Education M.S. in Automation, Hangzhou Dianzi University, 2012-2015. B.S. in Automation, Hangzhou Dianzi University, 2008-2012. Research and Application of Cost Control for Pharmaceutical Enterprises, master's thesis, 2015. English translation of the thesis title. Research Record The CNKI author profile was reviewed on October 12, 2026. Its public list contains 42 records: five journal articles, one master's thesis and 36 patent publication records. The patent publications represent 20 distinct inventions, 16 of which have a granted record. Application and grant publications for the same invention are counted once. Research Interests Multimodal AI and embodied intelligence. Data assets, data governance, knowledge graphs and enterprise software. Cloud-edge collaboration, asynchronous task scheduling and heterogeneous computing. Low-altitude UAV communication, sensing and logistics systems. Activity-based costing, cost variance analysis, predictive control and data warehouses. Academic Societies Committee Member, Zhejiang Association for Artificial Intelligence, August 2026 to present. Member, Chinese Institute of Electronics (CIE), current membership. Member, Chinese Association for Artificial Intelligence (CAAI), current membership.

documents.text: Professional Experience China Communications Services / Zhejiang Communications Services R&D Director and Chief Architect, May 2023 to present. He built an AI capability platform, organized a 50-person AI R&D team, and promoted engineering standards, reusable components, and technical documentation systems. He led the construction of a B2B DevOps platform, designed large-scale KMS architecture for attachment data and intelligent permission management, managed software product BOM systems, and received Hikvision's Golden Brick Award for two consecutive years.

documents.title: Zhouxing Zhao - Public Profile Overview
documents.summary: A public English overview of Zhouxing Zhao's background, research interests, and professional profile.
documents.text: Zhouxing Zhao - Public Profile Overview Zhouxing Zhao is an R&D Director, Chief Architect and Senior Engineer based in Hangzhou, China. His work focuses on AI engineering, multimodal systems, embodied intelligence, data governance, low-altitude UAV applications, cloud-edge collaboration, heterogeneous computing and intelligent scheduling systems. He currently works at Zhejiang Communications Services Co., Ltd. His public profile combines enterprise architecture, engineering management, research-oriented product development, and digital transformation delivery. Research and engineering interests include computer vision, large model applications, data governance, cloud-edge-device collaboration, low-altitude economy scenarios, UAV scheduling, DevOps platforms, knowledge graphs, and heterogeneous computing resource scheduling. His CNKI author profile lists research in computer software, multimodal systems, data elements and embodied intelligence. Earlier work includes activity-based costing, predictive control and data warehouses for pharmaceutical enterprises. Since August 2026, he has served as a Committee Member of the Zhejiang Association for Artificial Intelligence. He is also a member of the Chinese Institute of Electronics (CIE) and the Chinese Association for Artificial Intelligence (CAAI).

documents.title: Representative Research and Engineering Projects
documents.summary: Detailed project achievements in low-altitude UAV systems, data-driven code assembly, cloud-edge intelligent cores, and photovoltaic cloud-edge-device collaboration.
documents.text: Representative Research and Engineering Projects Professional UAV R&D and Applications for Typical Low-Altitude Scenarios Period: 2025 to 2026. Role: Core contributor, rank 4/30. Achievement: Developed a professional UAV platform for urban security, emergency communications, perception scheduling, intelligent recognition, and task collaboration. Built a unified scheduling platform for heterogeneous UAVs, supporting collaborative operation across different aircraft types. Technical focus: target detection, behavior recognition, intelligent scheduling algorithms, multi-mode navigation, anti-interference control, and real-time response in complex low-altitude environments. Data-Driven Code Assembly Platform Period: 2023 to 2025. Role: Project lead, rank 1/40. Achievement: Led an automated code assembly platform based on data-driven reuse, component reuse, modular code repositories, and knowledge graphs. The platform supports rapid component matching and intelligent assembly. Reported outcome: the platform improved average R&D efficiency by more than 30% according to the personal statement. Cloud-Edge Intelligent Core for Integrated Sensing and Collaborative Dispatching Period: 2025 to 2026. Role: Architecture lead. Achievement: Designed cloud-edge intelligent core architecture and lightweight AI inference technologies for constrained terminals. Technical focus: low-latency AI inference, cloud-edge-device collaboration, heterogeneous computing scheduling, and integrated sensing and dispatching. Key Technologies for Photovoltaic Cloud-Edge-Device Collaborative Intelligent Response Period: 2024 to 2025. Role: Project lead. Achievement: Researched cloud-edge-device collaboration in photovoltaic scenarios, including edge-side real-time monitoring, cloud-side intelligent scheduling, terminal response, and predictive maintenance models. Reported outcome: the personal statement records reported sales revenue of RMB 1 billion from this achievement.
